description: Search the UK Sanctions List (HM Treasury / FCDO consolidated financial sanctions designations) by name or alias. Returns matching designated parties with their aliases, regime, date of birth and nationality (for individuals), and the sanctions measures imposed. A `stale` flag is set when the underlying snapshot is older than the freshness window, and `retrieved` is false if no snapshot has ever been fetched yet.

query.description: Name, alias or exact ID number.

regime.description: Restrict to designations under this regime name.

name: uk_sanctions__search
title: Search UK Sanctions List
